reasons: Fails the vulnerability inclusion gate: CVSS 7.8 (<9.0), local LPE not pre-auth RCE, no in-the-wild exploitation, not on CISA KEV, upstream fix landed 2026-04-24 (~10 weeks old).

Only in-window event is the public PoC/write-up release (~2026-07-01..03); the underlying vuln+patch are out-of-window. In-window signal is tech-press amplification (THN, PBX Science, LHN) of a write-up that is not itself directly citable (GitHub PoC repo, not analysis).

Org-relevance for a Swiss federal SOC in 1-7d is low: patch available since April; action reduces to 'confirm April/May kernel updates applied'. No public detection signature/telemetry hook available.
Quiet 6h intraday window — zero entries is explicitly healthy; org-relevance over newsworthiness (PD-11).
